title: Gifts for Every Friend

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Brother Elias sent us the flowers you sowed with him in the winter! Look how they've grown.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: We'll give some to each of our friends from far away when they come to the festival. Would you share them out fairly?

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Share the flowers so every friend has the same.

older.prompt: Share twenty flowers fairly among six friends. Any left over will go on the festival table.

feedback.all_good: {n} flowers for every friend. What a welcome!

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: The seeds you sowed in the snow, given to the friends you made along the way. That's a lovely thing.

journal_line: I shared flowers grown at the monastery among our friends from far away.
